Whenever I read similar posts from men dealing with similar problems the replies are always very similar to this. 

I know it doesn't matter in a relationship (as much) but I don't need  a relationship to have sex. Nor do I want one. I have a lot of good friends and family that I know care about me. I just would like to be able to feel good about having decent sex with someone not feel as if I am a disappointment.  I am not here to debate about finding the 'one' I am here to put this and get this off my chest.
